It includes an increased input impedance, resulting in improved signal clarity. The drive knob offers more gain, allowing for a higher level of distortion. The pedal also incorporates asymmetrical clipping, which adds second order harmonics for a unique sound. Additionally, it provides more low-end frequencies, allowing for a fuller and more pronounced bottom end. The pedal also offers increased high frequencies, adding a touch of sparkle to the tone. The Li’l Modified Overdrive Kit utilizes all through-hole components, making it easy to assemble. It features panel-mounted hardware, ensuring a sturdy and reliable build. The pedal also includes true bypass, which ensures that the effect does not color the tone when disengaged. Summary created by AI from the original source.
